Scottish, Welsh, Northern Irish parties discuss independence summit

Representatives from political parties in Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland met to discuss potential independence referendums. The possibility of an independence referendum was stated as 'not off the table' following the meeting. The summit was organized by the parties to explore avenues for greater autonomy and self-determination.
